objectivesMapping.objective: Objective 1: Design a bilingual cybersecurity curriculum and diagnostic self-assessment framework tailored to Nigerian SME risk profiles.
objectivesMapping.implementation: 15 structured modules covering top Nigerian SME threats (POS tampering, fake credit alerts, WhatsApp takeover, SIM swaps, BEC) available in English and Nigerian Pidgin. Rich lesson protocols and 75 scenario-based quiz questions.

objectivesMapping.objective: Objective 2: Develop an adaptive learning recommendation engine that dynamically personalizes module sequencing based on business sector and diagnostic weakness.
objectivesMapping.implementation: Deterministic rule-based engine (getRecommendedModules in src/lib/adaptive-engine.ts) applying +20 priority weighting for diagnostic weakness and +10 for sector tag matches, filtering out completed modules.

objectivesMapping.objective: Objective 3: Implement an empirical Human Firewall Score (HFS) formulation combining training breadth with assessment validation mastery.
objectivesMapping.implementation: Formula: HFS = (completion_percentage * 0.35) + (average_quiz_score * 0.65). Dynamic awareness badges (Developing, Aware, Strong, Highly Aware), separated baseline benchmark, and 80% passing mastery threshold.

objectivesMapping.objective: Objective 4: Implement multi-role workplace security management with Role-Based Access Control and staff onboarding mechanisms.
objectivesMapping.implementation: Dedicated distinct dashboards for Business Owners, Employees, and Sole Entrepreneurs. 6-digit SME join codes for friction-free employee linking. Supabase RLS policies and server-side route guards enforcing tenant isolation.

objectivesMapping.objective: Objective 5: Deliver a high-usability, mobile-first responsive web interface optimized for Nigerian operational environments.
objectivesMapping.implementation: Next.js 16 App Router, Tailwind CSS design system with solid surfaces and card elevation depth, tactile physics (scale 0.97), 15 authentic Nigerian scenario images, Material Symbols outlined icon set, and bilingual toggle.

systemSpecs.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with custom canonical SME theme tokens
systemSpecs.authentication: Supabase Auth with Email/Password & OAuth providers
systemSpecs.buildOutput: 26 App Router routes (Static prerendered + Dynamic server-rendered)
